label: Snapshot ID
meaning: Unique snapshot ID; do not replace earlier snapshots.

label: Order-line ID
meaning: Stable buyer-scoped line identifier; all events join to this key.

label: Supplier ID
meaning: Stable pseudonymous supplier key; no fuzzy name matching.

label: Product ID
meaning: Stable exact specification/grade/pack identifier; preserve mapping locally.

label: Destination ID
meaning: Stable agreed receiving-site key, not an unnecessary personal address.

label: Release decision at
meaning: PO-line release/placement instant; equals order_placed_at for this first experiment. Freeze before outcomes.

label: Order placed at
meaning: Actual PO-line release/placement instant; equals decision_at for the first release-time model.

label: Original promise date
meaning: Original supplier-committed full-delivery date known at release, not merely the buyer request. Never backfill a later acknowledgement.

label: Original promise basis
meaning: Supplier source establishing the original promise. buyer_request_only/unknown are not verified commitments.

label: Buyer needed-by date
meaning: Buyer requested date; keep distinct from supplier-committed promise.

label: Destination timezone
meaning: IANA timezone for the promise-date deadline. Do not infer from currency.

label: Original quantity
meaning: Original ordered quantity, strictly positive. Later quantity changes are separate signals.

label: Purchasing unit
meaning: Exact each/kg/defined pack. No implicit conversion across receipts or records.

label: Unit price
meaning: Order-time documented unit price; leave unknown blank, never insert zero.

label: Currency
meaning: Three uppercase currency letters. Do not compare currencies without a reviewed mapping.

label: Business unit
meaning: Buyer unit known at decision, pseudonymized if needed.

label: Payment terms
meaning: Documented order-time terms, not later actual payment performance.

label: On contract
meaning: Documented contract status at decision; unknown stays unknown.

label: Snapshot verification
meaning: verified_as_of requires source support for availability of all populated fields.
